same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.api.compatibility_changed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: An actual compatibility probe replaces a previously committed compatibility assessment and changes at least one endpoint/version/release-state, schema pin, mutation-safety, scope, feature or rate/currentness fact. Unchanged re-observation saves no change. Unknown or failed compatibility remains mutation-closed; a changed assessment does not itself enable mutation.
families.family_specific_fence: Endpoint pins are per endpoint; a preview-only or absent route degrades only its dependent capability. A synthesized global API version is not evidence.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.api.compatibility_changed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.connection.capabilities_changed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.connection.reauthorized@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The credential owner has completed a successful reauthorization for the same provider/instance/account connection and returned a new verified non-secret grant/lease result. Opening protected sign-in, waiting, cancellation, a failed auth result or merely selecting an account cannot satisfy this predicate.
families.family_specific_fence: Broker custody and protected-browser restrictions remain external owners. Capture grant identity and scoped outcome only, with no token, code, credential path or protected-browser content.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.connection.reauthorized root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.connection.validated@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The exact connection test has a settled typed validation result. Record its actual succeeded, degraded, blocked or failed result, including the capability/currentness proof. Dispatch, cached labels, an unfinished probe and a different account test do not count as completed validation.
families.family_specific_fence: Validation does not create an account or repository and sign-in is not repository-write proof. A failed validation must not be rendered successful.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.connection.validated root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.mirror.connected root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.mirror.degraded root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.mirror.detached@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: A permitted, disclosed detach completes and commits effective mode detached, preserving the preceding topology and the successful transition receipt. An attempted or uncertain detach remains its truthful owner result and cannot be presented as detached.
families.family_specific_fence: Detach preserves the recovery/dedupe and capability re-resolution obligations. It never deletes repositories or silently transfers authority.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.mirror.detached root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.mirror.status_changed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: A committed mirror status changes mode, lag state or health from a particular prior topology snapshot. Store both exact snapshots; unchanged polling is not a transition. This status fact remains distinct from a connect/detach operation receipt and from a particular sync operation outcome.
families.family_specific_fence: Do not infer authority from direction, claim behind as current, or erase divergence. Any linked operation fact remains separately identified rather than reminted from this status.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.mirror.status_changed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.mirror.sync_completed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The exact previously started sync operation settles with a truthful terminal result and source/destination revisions. Completion records the actual succeeded, failed or cancelled outcome; it never implies every sync succeeded. An effect-unknown result requires reconciliation and is not a completed fact.
families.family_specific_fence: Join the original start, authoritative binding, dedupe identity and revision fence. An error result cannot carry a success indicator or successful exit status.

Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.mirror.sync_completed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.mirror.sync_started root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.pipeline.cancelled root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.pipeline.completed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The provider supplies a terminal succeeded, failed or skipped outcome for the exact started attempt. Preserve its jobs/checks completeness and currentness. Cancelled has its own cancelled fact; queued, running, waiting, unknown and effect-unknown are not completed outcomes.
families.family_specific_fence: The run state is not an individual gate status. Truncated checks retain their cursor and cannot certify the complete required-gate set.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.pipeline.completed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.pipeline.retried@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: An authorized retry has actually created or started the provider attempt identified in its retry result, linked to the exact earlier attempt. A retry request or uncertain result does not prove a new attempt. Same retry operation returns the original attempt and never triggers a second retry.
families.family_specific_fence: Direct revalidation of the exact automation generation, provider capability, revision, permission and currentness precedes retry. A stale or partial projection alone cannot authorize it.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.pipeline.retried root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.pipeline.started@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The provider has actually started the exact automation attempt, as shown by its provider result/current projection; admission or queued ObservableWork alone does not prove a started run. Preserve the immutable attempt identity and selected revision, including an absent review relationship where genuine.
families.family_specific_fence: Only the actual AutomationBinding selects service/provider/instance/account. Historical/external observations do not manufacture a PM command or ObservableWork.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.pipeline.started root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.repository.authority_changed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: A disclosed authorized transfer commits the requested/effective repository-function authority change between the exact prior and next bindings. The transfer receipt and revision fences prove the same storage/review/checks/issues/transport/mirror role. Actor-permission or account changes are different facts.
families.family_specific_fence: Legacy repository automation role is compatibility projection only; a transfer cannot select AutomationBinding, silently mutate a secondary, or infer a role from origin/upstream.

Leave genuine allocation authority, original source, selected current node, lifecycle/times, cursor/token and predecessor CAS unchanged. Staging times remain null. The candidate seed/ID are unique and recipe-correct; only actual seed-issuance provenance fails.
guards.isolation: Weaken only the actual issuance-provenance predicate with the shared tool in phase 2. Keep ID recipe and node-membership uniqueness enabled; neither is duplicate enforcement of issuance. Never reuse another node seed to target this predicate. Use the actual original SP-278 preparation/anchor and its seed/root binding; recipe equality is not rechecked as issuance.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.repository.authority_changed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.repository.created@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The create owner has verified the remote repository identity after a successful actual create for the exact reviewed provider/variant/instance/account/container/options. Accepted, effect-unknown, a reused existing repository or a URL without verified create proof does not mean created.
families.family_specific_fence: PJCT-007/010 original result, idempotency and reconciliation remain authoritative. A history retry cannot create another repository or automatically delete one; no paid signup or site publication is implied.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.repository.created root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.repository.discovered root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.repository.eligibility_changed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: A settled repository eligibility assessment for one requested operation changes from its prior assessment under the actual provider admission, access, capability and currentness evidence. Repeated assessment with the same outcome is not a change.
families.family_specific_fence: Eligibility is specific to an operation and current binding, not a global permission bit. Retired providers, transport-only routes and deferred restricted-token support remain refused.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.repository.eligibility_changed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.approved@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: One provider-native approval vote is saved for the exact reviewer and immutable review revision, using provider-asserted revision binding or the explicitly recorded Puppet Master observation binding. A missing binding cannot be shown as current approval. Preserve the required-reviewer fact and native vote identity.
families.family_specific_fence: A vote recorded against an earlier revision stays historical after any base/head/merge-base change. It never becomes an Orchestrator approval.granted record or authorizes merge by itself.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.approved root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.changes_requested@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.changes_requested root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.closed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The provider review has actually changed from open to closed without merge, preserving its exact current immutable revision and successful close result/observation. A close request or merged review is not this close-without-merge fact.
families.family_specific_fence: Failure or uncertainty leaves the truthful earlier state. Replaying history never sends close to the provider again or deletes review comments.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.closed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.created@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The provider confirms creation of the exact review, repository/head/base identities and first immutable revision. Preserve the actual Draft state and effective policy: agent creation defaults Draft unless that exact policy permits otherwise. A request, reused review or uncertain response is not creation.
families.family_specific_fence: Cross-repository review explicitly joins fork/head and original/base under FGI-024; a single repo ID or remote name cannot replace that pair. No automatic Ready or merge follows.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.created root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.marked_ready@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The separate authorized Mark Ready action has successfully changed this exact review from Draft to non-Draft. Its request carries draft=false and its current provider result confirms the change; a generic edit, draft=true, a request alone or already-Ready reobservation is insufficient.
families.family_specific_fence: Preserve direct current revision, effective authority, permission and idempotency checks. Mark Ready does not approve or merge the review.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.marked_ready root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.merged@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The provider confirms that this exact immutable review revision was merged with the explicitly selected admitted merge strategy and required gate/permission evidence. A queued/accepted merge, effect-unknown, approval or synthetic local merge cannot claim a merged review.
families.family_specific_fence: Keep provider-supported merge/strategy/currentness rules and cross-repository head/base joins. Replaying or retrying the history publication never merges again.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.reopened root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.thread.reopened@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The exact resolved discussion actually becomes unresolved under its permitted thread action, retaining provider thread identity, actor, full immutable revision window and tracking state. A different discussion, comment addition or repeat read of unresolved state is not reopening.
families.family_specific_fence: A thread anchor includes created-against, left and right revision refs plus tracking state/identity; partial or substituted windows cannot persist.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.thread.reopened root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.thread.replied root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.thread.resolved@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The exact unresolved discussion actually becomes resolved with its authorized resolution actor, complete immutable revision window and successful result. A resolve request, comment alone or repeated resolved observation is not a new resolution.
families.family_specific_fence: Resolution never proves the review approved or merged. It changes no blocking policy beyond the provider thread state already specified.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.thread.resolved root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.updated@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.updated root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.
