restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.review.version_created@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: A new immutable revision is committed because at least one exact base/head/merge-base leg changed, preserving previous/new triples and actual evidence-state cause. Unchanged triples, newest-label inference or a partially anchored revision do not create a version.
families.family_specific_fence: Completeness and evidence staleness are separate. A retarget or target-only move is not falsely called stale_head_changed, and old approvals/tests/captures remain bound to old triples.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.review.version_created root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.webhook.delivery_failed@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: Processing the exact previously received verified delivery has failed with an actual failure result and truthful retry/inspection/terminal recovery state. Failure is not signature rejection, unverified parsing or a successful processing result. No success exit status can accompany failure.
families.family_specific_fence: Original raw-body signature/time/context, replay and dedupe gates were satisfied before parsed effects. Re-observing the same failed processing attempt cannot repeat effects or remint a failure fact.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.webhook.delivery_failed root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.webhook.delivery_recovered root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.webhook.received@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The configured ingress has received this exact signed delivery and verified its raw-body signature before parsing, then time/context, fresh replay state and new dedupe state. This records verified receipt, not successful downstream processing. Invalid delivery belongs to rejected instead; duplicate delivery resolves its original fact.
families.family_specific_fence: Fast provider transport acknowledgement is distinct from durable EventRecord first receipt and processing completion. No raw body, signature secret or credential bytes enter history.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.webhook.received root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.webhook.redelivery_queued@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The exact authorized redelivery has been durably queued by the webhook recovery owner after current signature, time/context, replay, dedupe, delivery identity and redelivery-idempotency checks. A GUI click, unsupported operation or uncertain queue result is not queued.
families.family_specific_fence: Redelivery is linked to the original delivery and actual request identity; it does not reset the original occurrence, expiry clock or existing processing-effect identity.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative. Phase 2 turns this plan into fixtures, inventories each implementation enforcement site, and runs the shared guard-isolation tool; missing or masked fixtures keep criterion 12 PARTIAL. Compound prose descriptions denote a series of distinct cases, never a multi-defect input or multi-predicate cut. Derived seed uniqueness is documented as an entailment, not an independent guard requiring an impossible single-defect seed-reuse case. R1 node-membership and issuance cases, and R2 count-only/inclusive-resume cases, must be realized exactly as specified before phase-2 acceptance.

generation_invariant_dependencies.derived_seed_uniqueness: Within the forge.webhook.redelivery_queued root only the seed varies in the preimage. Same seed plus a correct recipe implies same ID. Unique ID array membership plus correct recipes implies distinct node seeds. Different seeds alone do not prove unique IDs.
generation_invariant_dependencies.enforcement: No separate seed-uniqueness refusal or negative. Repeated membership of an authentic node is checked by ID membership and does not require a second issuance. These independent predicates are never declared duplicates or removed together.
generation_invariant_dependencies.issuance_witness: Actual original durable SP-278 preparation/anchor, looked up by original seed and exact root identity; candidate generation_id-to-computed-ID equality is the separate recipe predicate.

positive_bases: fresh exact native fact after separate admission
same-key/same-body lost acknowledgement
restart before/after first receipt/source settlement
retained original after live state changes
retained authenticated compatibility and projector-replay-only history
mixed family/scope global scan with unrelated final record
actual empty retained source
SP-337 pending-intent pack and lawful physical value boundaries; current event payload is structurally below 4 KiB
three protected checkpoint generations and blocked fourth
compaction/recovery rebuild and withdrawn reader refusal

Use one stable, fully verified source selection containing an exact retained forge.webhook.rejected@1.0.0 event M in the actual scope, followed by one genuine unrelated final event U. Both source records, native facts and first receipts are valid; the complete scanned prefix is M,U. A valid predecessor has already covered M with cursor M and matched_count=1. Successful inclusive resume revalidates M and its value hash, skips the already-counted M, then examines U; publish cursor U and matched_count=1 using the genuine nine-field durable token, actual live snapshot fence, source and predecessor revision/hash whole-root CAS. No second disclosure, count increment or domain effect for M; U advances the cursor without increasing this family count. Repair candidate-dependent commitments and preserve original source.
families.family_specific_predicate: The configured ingress rejects an incoming delivery for signature, timestamp, context, unknown key, replay-window or conflicting-duplicate failure. Capture the trusted local ingress observation/decision identity and reason without parsing rejected raw input or trusting a supplied delivery identity. An ordinary already-accepted duplicate is a dedupe result, not a second rejection.
families.family_specific_fence: No effect dispatch or downstream body parse precedes verification. Rejection evidence is a bounded non-secret owner result; invalid bytes and protected material never become history content.

families.completion_rule: All listed schema/source/semantic predicates require their planned positive and exactly-one-defect negative.
